mechanism: Dorzolamide is a topical carbonic anhydrase inhibitor that can be systemically absorbed and may increase cyclosporine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and renal effects, while both drugs can affect renal function.
action: Monitor renal function and cyclosporine levels; use caution with concurrent systemic absorption of dorzolamide; consider alternative glaucoma therapy if renal impairment develops.
